title: C SOS: per-origin monotonic seq gate + per-origin rate limiter in sos_post
description: C slice of b7z9.121 (spec 18.4.1). lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c sos_post: (1) WIRE the per-origin monotonic Origin Sequence gate - the parsed origin_sig.origin_sequence is never compared against a per-origin last-seen table, so a stale-but-valid signed SOS replays. Add a small per-origin (keyed by origin IID, 8 bytes) last-seen uint64 table; accept only if origin_sequence strictly exceeds last-seen, update on accept. (2) Replace the single global s_sos_rl_state (coap_server.c:447, comment at :446 admits 'multi-source per-IID table is follow-up work') with a per-origin rate-limit table keyed by the same origin IID, so one chatty origin doesn't consume another's 3/hour budget. Both tables can share a bounded per-origin record array (seq + ratelimit state). Keep silent-drop (-ENOENT) semantics for all rejections per spec + sos_signature.json. Tests: extend lichen/tests/sos_ratelimit and/or a sos_post-level host test with two origins A and B - stale seq from A rejected while A's rate budget intact, and A's rate limiting must not suppress B. Landable independently of the AddrForKey slice.
